verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents baselining, diff-aware scanning, ignore annotations, or marking findings as false positives. A 'Triage findings' heading appears, but its content covers sending alerts and creating tickets, not suppressing existing findings. The ~20% AI noise reduction is a related post-processing feature, not a baseline or ignore capability that limits alerts to new issues.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can baseline or ignore existing and false-positive findings so only new issues alert
